slides.text: AI disciplines over time Prompting, agents, workflows and the factory on one large language model: how each reaches the model, and how much work it takes on.
Presets The AI disciplines timeline in its main Preset. Read the note on the Slide, then try its controls.

Presets (1/1) Page 1 of 1 The timeline Four disciplines on one language model, from prompting in 2022–23 to the factory emerging in 2026. Read me timeline What it shows The scale each discipline compares to, the four cards on the rail, a scene per discipline, its wire down to the model, and the model band. At rest nothing moves. What to try Move the mouse onto a column to play its scene. Click a card or the model band to turn it to its definition and source. Press "Play all" to play the four in turn. What to notice Every message to the model is a square down the wire and back: one for a prompt, three loops for an agent, three side by side at a workflow's fan-out, up to five at once for the factory. Comparable to a task a specialist a team an organisation 2022–23 Prompting You write, the AI answers. The entry point. Click: definition Definition Prompting is writing effective instructions so the model reliably gives you what you need. Source : OpenAI, prompt engineering guide ↗ ( opens in a new tab ) Summarise this report in 3 points. Sure: 1. … 2. … 3. … Chat a conversation, message by message 2024–25 Agents The AI uses tools and works in a loop. Click: definition Definition An agent is a language model that uses tools in a loop and decides for itself how to reach a goal. Source : Anthropic, Building effective agents (2024) ↗ ( opens in a new tab ) done Plan the team's trip to the trade fair. Open the web Search flights Three options, cheapest first. Harness the software around it: permissions, tools, loop 2024–25 Workflows Several agents, step by step, to a plan. Click: definition Definition A workflow chains model and tool steps along a path fixed in advance. Source : Anthropic, Building effective agents (2024) ↗ ( opens in a new tab ) Flowchart a graph: branch out, merge, check 2026 → · emerging Factory? Requests in, results out. What happens inside is still open. Click: definition Definition A factory turns specifications into software as a black box, agents working the whole line with no person writing or reviewing each step. Source : Shapiro, The Five Levels (2026) ↗ ( opens in a new tab ) ? End to end request in, result out The foundation, under every stage Large language model (LLM) It predicts, token A token is a piece of a word, such as "special" + "ist". Models read and write text in tokens. by token, which word piece most likely comes next, learnt from vast amounts of training text. ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude. Click: definition New tech nology brings ? Definition A large language model is an AI model trained on vast amounts of text that continues text token by token and is steered by text alone. Source : Brown et al. 2020, Language Models are Few-Shot Learners ↗ ( opens in a new tab ) ▶ Play all

The timeline Where the years and definitions come from Every year, definition and source on the cards comes from research LLM-0018, which dates each discipline by its primary source: ChatGPT's launch for prompting, Anthropic's agent definition and Claude Code for agents, LangGraph for workflows, and Dan Shapiro's five levels and StrongDM for the factory.
